'''Wilem''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]] in the [[Galactic War]], he was stationed at the [[Coronet City Spaceport/Legends|Coronet Spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], where he ran the small [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Wilem appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Cantina Vendor for Imperial players on Corellia.<ref name="TOR" />
